title: Cosmic Dog with Bubbles
description: A black and tan dog with large expressive brown eyes and perked ears looks upward with its mouth slightly open. Numerous translucent bubbles float around its head and chest, each containing miniature galaxies, stars, and nebulae in vibrant purples and blues.
prompt: A black and tan dog with bright amber eyes and perked ears gazes upward with a joyful expression, mouth slightly open revealing its tongue. Surrounding the dog are numerous transparent soap bubbles containing miniature galaxies, stars, and colorful nebulae in vivid purples and blues. Dramatic cosmic light rays shine from the upper right against a dark purple starry background with ethereal drapery, highly detailed digital painting.
